proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hz : (Set.range f).Finite :=
    .subset (Set.finite_Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T))
      (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr (by simp only [mem_Icc, Prod.mk_le_mk, hB, and_self, implies_true, f]))
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hz.not_infinite (Set.infinite_range_of_injective fun a b e => by
      contrapose! e
      exact (Nat.ne_iff_lt_or_gt.mp e).elim (h a b) fun h2 => (h b a h2).symm)
  have hr : ∀ n, (u (n + 4) : ℝ) = (fun (a, b, c, d) => (d + c + b * a) / (d * c + b + a)) (f n) :=
    fun n => (hu (n + 4) (by omega)).1
  have hp : ∀ m, f (i + m) = f (j + m) := by
    refine Nat.rec heq fun m ih => ?_
    have h4 : u (i + m + 4) = u (j + m + 4) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_inj (α := ℝ), hr, hr, ih]
    grind only
    tauto
  refine ⟨i, j - i, by omega, fun n hn => by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
    rw [show i + m + (j - i) = j + m from by omega]
    exact (congrArg Prod.fst (hp m)).symm⟩
